experience.description: Engineered a scalable EMR web application (Robosensy) using the MERN stack, improving API response time by 30% through query optimization and efficient schema design. projects.name: ResearchPilot
projects.description: A multi-agent AI research assistant built with LangGraph subgraphs (Research, Analysis, Critic) and a custom MCP server exposing stock price, news, and company fundamentals tools via yfinance/Tavily. Features human-in-the-loop review via LangGraph interrupt/checkpoint, a self-refine critic loop, and scheduled research jobs via APScheduler. Instrumented with LangSmith tracing and deployed with Docker on AWS EC2, with a Next.js frontend on Vercel.

projects.name: DocuMind
projects.description: A multi-agent document intelligence platform built with LangGraph — featuring 6 specialized agents (extraction, classification, summarization, risk, QA, routing) for automated processing of Hindi/English/Hinglish legal documents. Built a hybrid RAG pipeline (ChromaDB + BM25 + RRF) achieving ~85% retrieval accuracy on 50+ page multilingual legal corpora. Optimized latency from 56s to ~7s by bypassing LLM tool-calling serialization bottlenecks using Groq json_mode and implementing _chain_cache (speeding up RAG QA retrieval from 10s to 0.88s). Deployed with Docker on AWS EC2 with LangSmith tracing. Built as MCA capstone project.
